title: 2112. Finding the Largest of Two Numbers

Finding the Largest of Two Numbers
10
Easy
Problem Statement
Read two integers and print the larger of the two using an if-else statement.
Description
Read two integers a and b from input. Compare them using a relational operator inside an if-else statement, and print whichever value is larger. If both values are equal, print either one, since they are the same.
Input Description
Two integers a and b separated by a space.
Output Description
Print the larger of the two numbers.
Sample Input
8 15
Sample Output
15
